name: Dry Baseline
description: Stable dry-weather conditions with slight track temperature drop over a stint. Used as the default environment for tire and strategy modeling.

provenance.notes: Phase 3 has added weather evolution parameters (weatherTimeline) for dynamic environment coupling. Track temperature drift is a typical dry-session behavior.

assumptionNotes.note: Weather timeline is a deterministic authored input, not a weather prediction. The slight temperature drop represents typical afternoon track cooling.

values.notes: Stable dry conditions with slight track temperature drop over stint
